subject: Landlord inquiry intake and appraisal workflows for Progressive Property
body:
Hi Melissa,

I came across Progressive Property while looking into property management teams in Sydney, NSW. I noticed landlord appraisal enquiries and rental intake currently route through static inquiry forms.

If prospective landlord leads and appraisal requests are handled manually across inboxes, an automated intake and valuation workflow could pre-qualify property owners instantly and help your team secure new managements with less manual follow-up. At Cortech Solution, we build bespoke property software that automates landlord onboarding and intake triage.

I can put together a simple preview of how this could work for your team if you'd like to see it.

Best regards,

Syed Mesum Ali Shah
